# StratEdge Workflow

> Workflow intelligence for document-heavy financial operations — intake, documents, tasks, follow-up, and advisory AI in one control layer.

StratEdge Workflow Systems LLC builds software for credit unions, third-party administrators (TPAs), accounting firms, outsourced finance teams, and plan administrators who run recurring, document-heavy workflows.

## Key facts

- **Product:** StratEdge Workflow (live SaaS; public interactive tour on anonymized data)
- **Company:** StratEdge Workflow Systems LLC
- **HQ:** 4695 MacArthur Court, Newport Beach, CA 92660, USA
- **Contact:** info@stratedgeworkflow.com
- **Website:** https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/
- **Canonical facts:** https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/facts
- **Specifications:** https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/research/specifications
- **Status:** Live, with existing customers. Built for credit unions and third-party administrators.
- **AI:** Server-side, advisory assistant grounded in live workflow records — not autonomous filing or compliance decisions

## Products

- **StratEdge Workflow Control (SecureWorkflow.ai)** — live, with existing customers; built for credit unions and third-party administrators. Workflow control for document-heavy financial operations: intake, document tracking, task ownership, follow-ups, Needs Attention, advisory AI, audit trail.
- **RemitBot.ai** — live. The control layer for agent-to-agent payments: approved, limited, and traceable across any rail. https://remitbot.ai
- **CryptOps.ai** — live. Digital-asset operational security and transaction control: non-custodial risk score, Block / Hold / Clear, dual control, and an audit trail before broadcast. https://cryptops.ai (see https://cryptops.ai/llms.txt)
- ProofAudit.ai (live product): the evidence and auditability layer for high-stakes financial workflows. Every approval, with receipts. Public /try uses illustrative data. https://proofaudit.ai
- GuardRoute.ai (live product): GuardRoute controls what happens before it happens. The control layer for high-risk actions before execution. Public /try uses illustrative data. https://guardroute.ai
- Preview modules, not live: ClaimMesh and other named modules on the platform page. They are not live products. https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/platform
